intro.text: Beginning early 2025, I have started teaching, as a passion. As a result, I got to teach multiple courses at different online teaching programs.

courses.title: n8n Automations
courses.description: I created a course on how to use n8n to automate your workflows, including LLM based workflows.

courses.title: React beginners course
courses.description: I created a course on how to use React, teaching everything from the vdom to custom hooks.

courses.title: Lessons on current AI trends
courses.description: I taught lessons on current AI trends, including What LLMs are and what they can do, and what to look out for when using them. In these lessons, I taught ReTell, Lovable and n8n.

schools.name: CodingForHijra
schools.description: A school for total beginners to learn Web Development

schools.name: BuildFast
schools.description: A Program for people wanting to learn how to vibe coding

schools.name: Codebender
